description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the ratio and minFDE20 for different methods. The x-axis represents the ratio, with a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis represents minFDE20, with a linear scale ranging from 18 to 23, and tick labels at intervals of 1. The plot displays five lines, each representing a different method: TrajICL (blue, solid), Head Tuning (orange, solid), FT (green, solid), LoRA 16 (red, solid), and LoRA 64 (purple, solid). TrajICL decreases from approximately 20.2 at a ratio of 0.1 to around 18.0 at a ratio of 1.0. Head Tuning remains relatively stable, starting at around 22.9 at a ratio of 0.1 and ending at approximately 22.8 at a ratio of 1.0. FT fluctuates, starting at around 22.4, dips to 21.0 at a ratio of 0.7, then rises to 21.1 at a ratio of 1.0. LoRA 16 begins at 22.9 at a ratio of 0.1 and declines to 22.2 at a ratio of 1.0. LoRA 64 starts at 22.9 and decreases to 22.3 at a ratio of 1.0.
